title: Dustdevil Women Win on the Road: TAMIU Tops Colorado Christian 80-69 Behind Jaeda Wade's 18
excerpt: Freshman Jaeda Wade scored a team-high 18 points off the bench as the TAMIU women beat Colorado Christian 80-69 in Lakewood, improving to 2-2 on the season.
content:
LAKEWOOD, Colo. — Texas A&M International University women's basketball earned an 80-69 road victory over Colorado Christian University on Wednesday evening at the CCU Event Center, improving to 2-2 on the season.

Freshman Jaeda Wade provided the spark off the bench, scoring a team-high 18 points in 25 minutes on 6-of-14 shooting, including three 3-pointers. The Dustdevil bench accounted for 41 points in the win.

Four Dustdevils scored in double figures. Jah'Mareah Linville added 14 points, four rebounds, three assists and three steals; Carmen Morcillo scored 12 points on a perfect 4-of-4 from beyond the arc; and Kimora Carroll added 10 points and three assists. Abigail Martinez contributed nine points, six rebounds, four steals and two assists, and Bright Eze led TAMIU on the glass with a team-high nine rebounds.

TAMIU led 17-9 after the first quarter, holding Colorado Christian to nine points while forcing six turnovers, and took a 36-31 lead into halftime. The Dustdevils took control in the third quarter, outscoring the Cougars 23-15 to lead 59-46 entering the fourth, scoring 11 points off turnovers and six fast-break points in the period.

Colorado Christian (0-3) scored 23 points in the fourth quarter but never closed the gap. Ezra Simonich led the Cougars with 22 points and 13 rebounds for a double-double, and Jacy Chandler added 14 points.

As a team, TAMIU shot 44.8 percent from the field (30-of-67) and 41.2 percent from three-point range (7-of-17), forced 21 turnovers with 12 steals, and scored 21 points off turnovers to Colorado Christian's 10.

The Dustdevil men (1-2) were also in action this week, hosting the College of Biblical Studies on Thursday evening at the TAMIU Kinesiology and Convocation Building after Tuesday's 76-74 comeback win over Southwestern Adventist. The men travel to Angelo State on Monday, Nov. 23.

Sources: Texas A&M International University Athletics (godustdevils.com), Nov. 18, 2026; Colorado Christian University Athletics (ccucougars.com), Nov. 18, 2026; Sportradar, Nov. 2026.
